title: Kissed British Chicken Curry
description: A gentle, sweet‑tender chicken curry with a silky sauce, finished with a bright sweet chili glaze and aromatic tadka, perfect for a romantic, sugar‑free evening.

ingredients.name: tadka seeds
ingredients.notes: 1 tsp cumin + 1 tsp mustard + pinch red chili flakes

instructions: Heat butter in a large pan over medium heat until melted and slightly browned.
Add finely sliced onion and sauté until translucent and fragrant.
Stir in garlic‑ginger paste and cook for 1 minute until aromatic.
Add diced chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Mix in yogurt, coconut milk, sweet chili sauce, and garam masala, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and let the curry steam for 15 minutes, allowing the chicken to become tender.
While the curry simmers, prepare the tadka: heat oil in a small skillet, add cumin and mustard seeds until they pop, then pour over the simmering curry.
Stir in lime juice, adjust salt to taste, and sprinkle chopped cilantro.
Reduce heat and let the sauce thicken, stirring occasionally, for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot over steamed rice or flatbread, garnishing with extra cilantro if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
